extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants, patent attorneys/agents and offices using the PCT international (international-phase) procedures
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and procedural/quality requirements for preparing and prosecuting international (PCT) applications and for international search, publication, preliminary examination and transition to national phase.

rubrics_metrics.name: International Preliminary Examination (general)
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural and substantive rules governing international preliminary examination (IPE): criteria for IPE, timing (start/time available), effects of IPE, postponement, languages accepted, special requirements for nucleotide/amino acid sequence listings, applicant communication with IPEA, competence limits, and relationship to international preliminary reports and later national phases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mentions: criteria at 10.001, 10.057-10.060; delay and postponement provisions; request by IPEA for priority document/translation (10.056); 'telescoped' procedure overlapping IS and IPE (10.052); time available depends on earliest possible submission of demand after ISR (10.010); extent of confidentiality (11.074); unity of invention issues during IPE; written opinion during IPE.

rubrics_metrics.name: International Preliminary Report on Patentability (IPRP) (Chapter I) — availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Copies of IPRP (Chapter I) are only made available after expiration of 30 months from the priority date; provisions for issuing under Art.19 and Art.34 and related statements accompanying the report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: References: 'copies of — only made available after expiration of 30 months from priority date' (7.031); issuance under Art.19 (9.010) and Art.34 (9.011); statement accompanying (10.025-10.026, 10.028, 10.053-10.055).

rubrics_metrics.name: IPRP (Chapter I) — biological material and sequence listings
rubrics_metrics.description: Biological material samples may be obtained in connection with an IPRP (Chapter I); sequence listings and special requirements may apply during examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mentions biological material sample obtainable (11.085) and special requirements for nucleotide/amino acid sequence listings during IPE (10.063); Annexes C, E referenced for languages.

rubrics_metrics.name: IPRP (Chapter I/II) — competence and document access
rubrics_metrics.description: Competence limitations of the authority issuing the IPRP; copies of cited documents may be obtainable from the authority; transmittal of copies and translations to designated Offices (DOs) and applicant handled by the IB.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Competence of authority referenced (10.006-10.009, Annexes C, E); copies of cited documents available (10.082); transmittal by IB to DOs (9.001(iv)); limitation of competence (10.006).

rubrics_metrics.name: IPRP (Chapter II) — legal status and access
rubrics_metrics.description: IPRP (Chapter II) is not binding on Examining Offices (EOs); it contains opinions on patentability and may be accessed by persons other than the applicant under specific rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: References: '— not binding on EOs' (10.083); IPRP (Ch II) contains opinion on inventive step/other patentability matters (10.075, 10.083); access to IPRP by others (9.027, 10.003, 10.080-10.081, 11.074).

rubrics_metrics.name: IPRP (Chapter II) — amendments and comments
rubrics_metrics.description: Amendments going beyond original disclosure may be commented on in the IPRP; the IPRP may cite relevant documents and indicate claims for which no ISR was established.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mentions amendments going beyond original disclosure commented on in IPRP (10.070, 11.047); citations of relevant documents (10.075); indication of claims relating to inventions without an ISR (10.062); deadline for taking amendments/arguments into account (10.024, 10.028, 10.061, 10.068).

rubrics_metrics.name: International Publication — form, timing and contents
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on international publication of the International Application (IA): form and contents, publication number, language, timing and time limits, and IB transmittal procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: References: general rules 9.001(iii), 9.012-9.027; form and contents (10.075); number (9.015); language of publication (10.078); time limit for establishing publication (10.010, 10.074); transmittal by IB to DOs (10.003, 10.079, 11.074).

rubrics_metrics.name: International Publication — confidentiality and patentability statement
rubrics_metrics.description: Confidentiality rules until publication; the IPRP expresses no opinion on patentability of the IA at publication stage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Confidentiality of IAs until publication (6.004); 'patentability — expresses no opinion on' (10.077); priority document relations to publication (10.056).

rubrics_metrics.name: International Preliminary Examining Authority (IPEA) — competence and limits
rubrics_metrics.description: IPEA competence is defined with limits; IPEA cannot force an applicant to change the International Application (IA); rules cover amendments filed with IPEA, language, form, legal effects, and handling of rectification/withdrawals relative to completion of IPE.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See 10.001, 10.006-10.009: '— cannot force applicant to change IA' (10.069); amendments filed with IPEA (10.071, 11.074); form and contents (9.015-9.020); legal effects (9.024); physical requirements compliance checked only to extent required for reasonably uniform IAs (6.032(v)); withdrawals and rectification time limits (9.012(iii), 11.039, 11.048-11.056).

rubrics_metrics.name: International Searching Authority (ISA) — general duties
rubrics_metrics.description: The ISA performs the international search, notifies receipt of copies, may establish the abstract, prepare listings, may obtain biological samples, and sets the basis/limits of search. It may refuse to search certain subject matter or where IA is unclear/defective.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See 7.001-7.032 and cross-references: fees; notification of defects (6.051); notification of receipt of search copy (9.002); abstract establishment (5.173, 7.022); listings (7.005-7.012); basis for search (7.003); refusal to carry out search (7.013); unclear/defective IAs (7.014).

rubrics_metrics.name: International Search (IS) — meaningful search and claim drafting
rubrics_metrics.description: The manner of claiming affects whether the ISA can do a meaningful search; limitations on searches and meaningful search definitions are specified.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Claiming manner affects ability to do meaningful search (5.113); 'meaningful —' referenced (5.113); limitations on search (7.013-7.014); partial search results included where lack of unity (7.017).

rubrics_metrics.name: International Search Report (ISR) — contents and restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: The ISR sets out search results for the main invention and related parts; it must not contain expression of opinion, reasoning, argument or explanation; it is published with the IA and becomes available to the public after international publication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: General references 7.023-7.026; '— must not contain expression of opinion, reasoning, argument or explanation' (7.024); '— available to public after international publication' (11.073); established on parts relating to main invention (7.018); published with IA (7.025, 9.015).

rubrics_metrics.name: ISR — amendments and timing
rubrics_metrics.description: Amendment of claims under Art.19 allowed after receipt of ISR except where ISA declared no ISR would be established; demand filing timing (file demand ASAP after evaluating ISR).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Amendment of claims allowed after receipt of ISR (5.127, 9.004, 11.045); not allowed where ISA declares no search (9.004); demand should be filed ASAP after ISR evaluation (10.010).

rubrics_metrics.name: ISR — documentation and copies
rubrics_metrics.description: Documents cited in the ISR can be identified and copies obtained; the documentation searched is listed and earlier search/classification results may be transmitted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Documents cited in ISR and obtaining copies (7.026); documentation searched by ISA (7.004); earlier search results transmitted (5.073B); copies of documents obtainable from IPEA (10.082).

rubrics_metrics.name: ISR — effects on later procedure and national phase
rubrics_metrics.description: Lack of or partial ISR does not influence validity of the IA; partial search results due to lack of unity included; protests/decisions may be notified to DOs; usefulness in national phase and effect of ISR/IPRP on national phase are addressed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lack/partial does not influence validity (7.013-7.021); partial search results included (7.017); protest text and decision may be notified to DOs (7.019); usefulness in national phase (10.057, 10.083); effect of IPE on national phase (10.002).

rubrics_metrics.name: International Searching Authority Specified for Supplementary Search (SISA)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules regarding choice, competence, commencement, documentation submission and language acceptance for a SISA performing supplementary international searches.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: General references 8.001, 8.003-8.004, 8.039; choice indicated in request for SIS (8.011); competence and limitations (8.001, 8.041-8.042); documentation submitted directly to SISA (8.038); languages accepted listed in Annex SISA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invitation by IPEA
rubrics_metrics.description: IPEA may invite the applicant to correct defects (including those in the demand), to furnish sequence listings, to submit indicated amendments, to provide translation of priority documents, or to file written replies to the written opinion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Invitations for lack of unity (10.072); to correct defects in demand (10.044, 10.047-10.048); to furnish sequence listings (7.005-7.012, 10.063, 11.088); to submit amendments indicated in demand (10.055); translation of priority document (10.056); written reply to written opinion (10.066).

rubrics_metrics.name: Internet — electronic filing and guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Forms and guidelines available online: PCT forms, administrative instructions, Applicant’s Guide, procedures for electronic sequence listings, paying additional search fees, official notices and other internet-based services and instructions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: References include: online forms (5.015, 10.012), Guidelines on the internet (1.008), submittal of sequence listings online (5.099-5.100, 7.005-7.012, 11.088), online payment procedures, PCT Newsletter and Gazette availability, and Annex B/C references for electronic filing procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invention(s) — disclosure and drawings
rubrics_metrics.description: The description must disclose the invention in a clear and complete manner; drawings are required in the IA where necessary to understand the invention; additional sheets and corrections procedures are specified.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: References: disclosure standards (5.094-5.097); drawings required where necessary (5.010); receipt of further sheets after deadlines (6.026); correction of Art.11/Art.14 defects and furnishing corrections (6.025, 6.032, 6.001(iii)); further detail 5.128-5.163.

rubrics_metrics.name: Irregularities and proof of right to patent
rubrics_metrics.description: Irregularities (including microbiological matters) may be treated specially; proof of right to the patent may be required by Designated Offices (DOs); the IA must be for protection of an invention.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes: 'Proof of right to — may be required by DOs' (5.086); IA subject must be protection for invention (5.002); microbiological issues see Biological Material section.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventive step (non-obviousness)
rubrics_metrics.description: Inventive step is a defined criterion for International Preliminary Examination (IPE) and is one of the IPE criteria; lack of inventive step is addressed in written opinions and IPRP (Chapter II) may contain an opinion on inventive step.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defined for IPE (10.059); one of IPE criteria (10.001, 10.057); lack of inventive step may be commented on in written opinion (10.064(ii),(iii)); prior art assists determination (7.003).

rubrics_metrics.name: Kinds of protection (scope beyond patents)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Guide distinguishes kinds of protection and identifies other forms of protection aside from patents relevant to IA subject matter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See 'K' entries 5.002, 5.055 for other types of protection; references to national practice differences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Languages accepted for filing and examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on which languages are accepted by Receiving Offices (RO), ISAs and IPEAs, the effect of filing in a language other than the language of publication, and obligations to furnish translations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: References: languages accepted for examination by IPEA (Annex E); filing IA with RO (5.013, 6.013-6.023, 6.034, Annex C); languages accepted by each ISA for IS (5.013-5.014, 6.013-6.023, 6.034, Annex D); translation rules and IB-prepared English translations (9.017, 9.001(vii), 10.078).

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventor(s) — identification and requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on who may be an inventor, identification details required, corporate entity limitations, recommended inclusion of name/address, and the 'Inventor only' check-box on forms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Corporate applicant/legal entity cannot be inventor (5.024); recommended to include name and address (5.036); 'Inventor only' check-box (5.036, 5.039); identification of inventor (5.035-5.037); changes in inventorship handled in change sections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Omissions and amendments
rubrics_metrics.description: Omission of information from the IA or from publication is treated as an amendment; omission of entire elements or sheets may not be rectifiable; omission specifics for claims, description, drawings are given.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Omission considered an amendment to IA (10.067); omission of certain info from publication (9.016A, 11.073A); omission of entire elements/sheets not rectifiable (11.034); omission of a sheet of claims/description/drawings references (5.126, 5.110, 5.161).

rubrics_metrics.name: New matter — amendments restriction
rubrics_metrics.description: Amendments during the international phase may not introduce new matter; new matter may be commented on in written opinions and affected statements for sequence listings apply.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: New matter in amendments during international phase prohibited (10.070, 11.047); may be commented on in written opinion (10.064(iv)); sequence listing statements regarding new matter (7.010).

rubrics_metrics.name: Novelty
rubrics_metrics.description: Novelty (lack of novelty) is defined for the purposes of IPE and is one of the examination criteria; lack of novelty is subject to comment in written opinion and prior art is relevant to determination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defined for IPE (10.058); one of IPE criteria (10.001, 10.057); lack of novelty commented in written opinion (10.064(ii),(iii)); prior art assists determination (7.003).

rubrics_metrics.name: Nucleotide/amino acid sequence listings — requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Sequence listings may be required by ISAs/IPEAs, may need to be furnished in special and/or electronic forms, and there are associated timing and furnishing rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sequence listings references: 5.099-5.100, 7.005-7.012, 11.088; may be required in electronic form (5.099-5.100, 7.012, 11.088); optional biological material indications sheet rules (11.082).

rubrics_metrics.name: Numbering and formatting requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Numbering rules for applications, sheets, drawings, lines, sequence listing parts, and page/line conventions to meet PCT form requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numbering of amended claims (9.005); numbering of drawings (5.012, 5.140-5.142); numbering of IA sheets (5.012, 5.106); numbering of lines and sequence listing parts (5.106, 7.009); dates and format (5.061).

rubrics_metrics.name: Margins and physical paper requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Margin requirements for Request and Demand forms and minimum margins for IA papers; physical requirements checked only to extent needed for uniform publications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Margins in request (5.087) and demand (10.025(ii)); minimum margins for IA papers (5.105, 5.133, 5.159); physical requirements compliance checked to extent required for reasonably uniform IAs (6.032(v)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Representation before authorities
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for representation before ISAs, IPEA and in the international procedure including relevant box entries on forms and requirements for appointment/notification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Representation references: 5.042-5.045, 10.019-10.021, 11.001, 11.002, 11.004, 11.008-11.010, 11.017; Box No. IV (agent) and related form instructions (5.043, 5.047, 5.051).

rubrics_metrics.name: Late arrival / late payment / late receipt — excusal and consequences
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules concerning late arrival of letters, late payment of fees and late receipt of IA sheets; provisions on excusing delay/loss and related fee consequences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Late arrival of letter (11.063-11.064); late payment of fees (6.009, 10.042 and fee rules 5.193-5.195); late receipt of IA sheets (6.026); loss/delay in mail excused provisions (11.063-11.064).

rubrics_metrics.name: National phase — timing and requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: General rules for entering the national phase, time limits, relationship to IPE (effect of IPE on start), and document/fee requirements in national phase.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: National phase general references (2.002, 3.004-3.005); time limit for entering national phase (4.016); effect of IPE on start of national phase (10.002); requirements for national phase noted as 'Nat. Phase'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Official Notices (PCT Gazette) and public information
rubrics_metrics.description: Publication and updating of official notices (PCT Gazette) including indications about biological material, extension of IA, waivers and updates of time limits and non-working days.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Official Notices general (1.005); indications concerning biological material and depositary institutions (11.078-11.080, 11.083-11.084); extension of IA to successor State (11.091-11.092); waivers published (5.044, 11.008, 11.009).

rubrics_metrics.name: Oral communication with IPEA
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants have the right to oral communication with the IPEA during international preliminary examination under specified procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicitly noted: 'right of applicant to — with IPEA during IPE' (10.067).
